subgoals.description: Search for potential venues in Edinburgh using a venue search tool
subgoals.success_criterion: List of at least 3 venues with basic details (name, location)

subgoals.description: Gather detailed information (price, capacity, amenities) for each venue from the list
subgoals.success_criterion: Detailed data for each venue in the list

subgoals.description: Draft a professional flyer highlighting key features of the selected venue
subgoals.success_criterion: Completed flyer document with venue details and appealing content
